title: Wonderful day with many exciting experiences
text: The trip was amazing, Xavier drove us from the hotel and back. We visited two towns near Casa Brava. Our guide, Aurora, was wonderful. She lived in the first town and was quite knowledgeable about each town we toured. She asked us, if we would like to do an oil tasting and was as be to put that together on the spur of the moment. We were able to do that and then Xavier took us to lunch in Casa Brava right on the beach of the Mediterranean Sea. Couldn’t ask for a nicer day.
author: FrequentFlier41269

title: Fantastic excursion!
text: Such a great experience.   Had a wonderful tour with a great lunch by the water.  Loved it from start to finish.  Exceeded all expectations!
author: Nicholas W

title: Costa Brava experience.
text: Great to experience a local marketplace teeming with people shopping and not tourists.  The sights of the coastal towns were incredible.  Being the low season we had easy access.  We enjoyed a delicious local food overlooking the calm sea with our friendly and informative guide.
author: Michael_N

title: Glimpse of Catalalan Countryside
text: We were able to customize the tour to include the Mercat de Palafrugell, a bustling marketplace without the extreme crowds of the La Boqueria and people shopping for their needs rather than tourists. The costal views were beautiful though the coastal villages were mostly closed since it’s mid-December, we took advantage of almost no crowds walking a coastal path.  The views from the lighthouse was gorgeous.  We stopped at a nearby restaurant overlooking the ocean for a delicious casual lunch of Catalan dishes.  Our driver, Xavier was welcoming, friendly and informative.
author: Miken9875

title: Superb! Great!
text:
Xavier was wonderful! Knowledgeable, Prompt, Professional and simply great!
The tour was beautiful and was one of our highlights!
author: Monica P
